name: DETOX-P2
source: Hosseini, K., Sigloch, K., Tsekhmistrenko, M., Zaheri, A., Nissen-Meyer, T. & Igel, H. (2020), Global mantle structure from multifrequency tomography using P, PP and P-diffracted waves, Geophys. J. Int. 220(1), 96-141, https://doi.org/10.1093/gji/ggz394 (model DETOX-P2: P + Pdiff)

evidence.units: Grid values are dlnVp in percent: sampling the 1000 km and 2000 km grids at the native tetrahedral nodes (DETOX-P2.solx, labelled dlnVp, fractional) gives slopes 97.3 and 98.2 with r = 0.999 (100 less spline smoothing).
evidence.depth_reference: Grid depths are measured below a 6371 km surface: the same regression with a 6421 km reference (the native mesh's outer radius) drops to r = 0.97-0.98.
evidence.polarity: Positive dlnVp is fast, i.e. cold; subducted slabs appear as positive anomalies (high_means = fast).
evidence.resolution: Native 0.5 deg x 0.5 deg x 50 km (720 x 361 x 59 after dropping the repeated 360 deg column); not resampled.
evidence.choice_of_model: DETOX-P2 (P + Pdiff): the paper's abstract reports that Pdiff data sharpen subducted-slab geometries under the Americas, Eurasia and the Northern Pacific in the upper 2000 km; DETOX-P3 adds PP but introduces low-velocity artefacts beneath oceans.
evidence.encode_range: clip_percentile 99.9, not the 99.5 used for REVEAL/SEMUCB/UU-P07: at 99.5 (+-0.94 %) the Verification Card showed 2-3 % of cells clamped from 0 to 300 km, where strong upper-mantle anomalies (slab cores among them) sit. At 99.9 (+-1.46 %) one stored level is 0.0115 %, still far finer than the signal.
evidence.default_display: default_clip +-0.5 %, the 95th percentile of |dVp| over the volume (0.498 %), rather than prep_model's default of half that (+-0.25 %), which rendered most of the cutaway and depth slice saturated.
